headings.text: HargaPas menyatukan daftar menu, hitungan HPP, dan konsultan AI dalam satu laporan harga. Untuk warung yang ingin tahu untung sebelum menaikkan harga.
Ubah lima komponen HPP dan target margin. Harga jual, margin nyata, dan dampak bulanannya ikut berubah.
Bawa satu menu dan satu masalah. Jawabannya memakai HPP, harga, dan jumlah piring yang Anda masukkan, bukan rata-rata pasar.
Delapan menu contoh, diurutkan dari margin tertipis. Angka diambil dari HPP dan harga jual yang Anda masukkan.
Lima komponen ini membentuk HPP satu piring. Bahan baku yang paling besar, tetapi kemasan dan susut tetap dihitung.
Mulai gratis untuk satu menu. Naik saat jumlah menu, pengguna, atau cabang bertambah.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "HargaPas menyatukan daftar menu, hitunga…" → 5 lines at 22px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Coba dulu" above "Warung"; "Pilih Warung" above "Dapur"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1164px at 10096px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
